EVAL-F5-S7.title: Explainability Schema and Contract Definition
EVAL-F5-S7.description: Define a standardized explainability schema covering source, meaning, and limitations for all evaluation signals, ensuring compatibility across provider credentials, external links, and clinical trials outputs.

EVAL-F5-S8.title: Explainability Core Logic Builder
EVAL-F5-S8.description: Implement backend logic to generate explainability objects for each evaluation signal by enriching provider credentials, verification links, and clinical trial signals with contextual explanations and limitations.

EVAL-F5-S9.title: Explainability API and Chat Rendering Integration
EVAL-F5-S9.description: Extend evaluate care facade responses to include explainability payloads and ensure frontend chat components render explanations clearly alongside evaluation signals without breaking message formatting.

EVAL-F5-S10.title: Explainability Unit and Integration Tests
EVAL-F5-S10.description: Create unit tests for explainability generation logic and integration tests validating that explainability fields are consistently present and correctly structured in end-to-end evaluation responses.
